segments.text: Hey guys today, I'm going to show you how to use a centrifuge. I know you are thinking Dan
segments.zh: 大家好，今天我要教你们怎么用离心机。我知道你们在想：Dan，

segments.text: How could it be to use a centrifuge? Well, I'm going to show you some of the commonly made mistakes
segments.zh: 用个离心机能有多难？好吧，我要给你们看看一些常犯的错误。

segments.text: This is a standard tabletop centrifuge
segments.zh: 这是一台标准的台式离心机。

segments.text: Here is a temperature control tabletop centrifuge, so this is a bigger centrifuge for bigger tubes
segments.zh: 这是一台温控台式离心机，所以这是一台更大的离心机，用于更大的离心管。

segments.text: This is not a washing machine. It's actually a high-speed centrifuge
segments.zh: 这可不是洗衣机。它其实是一台高速离心机。

segments.text: You don't mess with it
segments.zh: 可别乱动它。

segments.text: No matter which centrifuge you use, there are a few things you need to remember
segments.zh: 无论你用哪种离心机，都有几件事需要记住。

segments.text: The first thing you need to know when you use a centrifuge is to make sure you use the right size of
segments.zh: 使用离心机时，你需要知道的第一件事，就是确保为相应的离心机

segments.text: Tube for the right centrifuge
segments.zh: 使用尺寸合适的离心管。

segments.text: Here is a commonly used 1.5 mil microfuge tube that fits in most of the tabletop centrifuge
segments.zh: 这是常用的 1.5 毫升微量离心管，适用于大多数台式离心机。

segments.text: Here is a half mil of microfuge tube that would also fit into the centrifuge
segments.zh: 这是一支 0.5 毫升的微量离心管，也能放进这台离心机。

segments.text: But if you use this one, you'll have to use an adapter
segments.zh: 但如果你用这种管，就得用一个适配器。

segments.text: So you place it in an adapter like that and use it. If you don't, the tube might break
segments.zh: 所以你要像这样把它放进适配器里再用。如果不这样做，管子可能会破裂。

segments.text: The second thing you need to watch out for is you have to balance your tubes
segments.zh: 第二件需要注意的事是，你必须配平离心管。

segments.text: So here since the volume you can put in the tube are small
segments.zh: 在这里，由于管里能装的体积很小，

segments.text: So you don't have to weigh them
segments.zh: 所以你不用称重。

segments.text: All you have to do is make sure the solution in the two tubes are at the same level
segments.zh: 你只需要确保两支管中溶液的液面高度相同。

segments.text: As you can see now the tubes are not balanced. One of them is at approximately 1 mil, the other one is at half mil
segments.zh: 如你所见，现在这两支管没有配平。其中一支大约是 1 毫升，另一支是 0.5 毫升。

segments.text: So in order to balance the one mil tube, you should have another tube which also has one mil of solution in it like that
segments.zh: 所以为了配平这支 1 毫升的管，你应该再准备一支同样装有 1 毫升溶液的管，像这样。

segments.text: Now I'm going to show you how to balance your samples in a centrifuge
segments.zh: 现在我要给你们演示如何在离心机中配平样品。

segments.text: We are looking at a centrifuge rotor right now
segments.zh: 我们现在看到的是离心机转子。

segments.text: You have to place your sample
segments.zh: 你必须把样品

segments.text: directly
segments.zh: 正

segments.text: across from each other. That's how you balance it. If you only have one sample
segments.zh: 对面地放置。这就是配平的方法。如果你只有一个样品，

segments.text: you can take a second centrifuge tube, just fill it up with the same volume of water
segments.zh: 可以另拿一支离心管，装入相同体积的水，

segments.text: then you'll have your centrifuge balanced
segments.zh: 这样你的离心机就配平了。

segments.text: The third thing you need to do when you use a centrifuge is that you always have to secure
segments.zh: 使用离心机时，你需要做的第三件事是，必须始终像这样把

segments.text: the rotor lid onto the rotor like that. Make sure it's secured, then you can close the centrifuge
segments.zh: 转子盖固定在转子上。确保它固定好了，然后才能关上离心机。

segments.text: The last thing we need to check before we use the centrifuge is to check the setting
segments.zh: 使用离心机之前，我们需要检查的最后一件事是检查设置。

segments.text: There are usually two settings, one is time, the other one is speed
segments.zh: 通常有两项设置，一项是时间，另一项是转速。

segments.text: Time isn't really that important here, but what's most important is the speed
segments.zh: 在这里时间其实没那么重要，最重要的是转速。

segments.text: You want to make sure the centrifuge is set at a speed that is not going to break the tube
segments.zh: 你要确保离心机设置的转速不会让管子破裂。

segments.text: That's how you use a centrifuge. Just remember always use the right tube, properly balance
segments.zh: 这就是离心机的用法。只要记住：始终使用合适的离心管，正确配平

segments.text: your sample, secure the rotor lid, and use the right setting. If you follow these steps
segments.zh: 你的样品，固定好转子盖，并使用正确的设置。如果你按照这些步骤做，

segments.text: you should be fine, but if you don't, the centrifuge could explode
segments.zh: 应该就没问题，但如果不这样做，离心机可能会爆炸。

segments.text: What? It's happened before! See you guys next time
segments.zh: 什么？以前真发生过！下次见。
